reviewQuestions: Independently read each complete paragraph, its whole palace section, its natal star subsection, and full derived/raw source. Reject if any governing condition makes direct-host-only text attribution unsupported.

Can the exact opening-clause-only Vietnamese annotation apply when the named star is directly hosted, while all cohost/brightness/natal/adverse qualifiers remain explicit retained context and are not evaluated? Reject rather than inventing absence, standalone or imported natal conditions.
Nô Bộc wording explicitly means historical servants. Do not silently generalize to friends, employees or colleagues. Does exact wording preserve this source-limited meaning?

Thiên Cơ Điền Trạch cohost branches include Cự Môn Mão inheritance/Dậu no inheritance and relative size, Thiên Lương late wealth and Thái Âm self creation. Is exact opening-only wording defensible without asserting any actual property outcome?
Cự Môn Thiên Di ends with six-adverse intensifier. Do not erase it, infer a no-adverse requirement, or label chart behavior/mental health.

Independently reproduce positive/negative direct-host fixtures including both genders, cohost/standalone/adverse cells, wrong-host/opposite-only negatives. Missing model/tool/witness evidence is incomplete, not approval.
No phrase claims empirical truth, complete-palace synthesis, grade, health, future fortune, natal source equivalence, generic VCD permission, public interpretation, AI narration or release.
